label: conj:binding-scale-catalan
title: Binding energy scale $\alpha = m_e \times 8G$
html:
The binding energy scale in the atomic mass formula is the archimedean evaluation of the algebraic binding scale:

  \alpha_q = m_e \times \mathrm{Vol}_q(\mathcal{B}_3)
  \;\in\; \mathbb{Z}[q^{1/2}, q^{-1/2}]

where \mathcal{B}_3 = (\sigma_0\sigma_1^{-1})^3 \in B_3 is the canonical Borromean braid word (closure: the Borromean rings {6^3_2}, three mutually unlinked yet inseparable components), and \mathrm{Vol}_q(\mathcal{B}_3) = \prod \hat{V}_i^{\mathcal{B}_3}(q) is its algebraic quantum volume (algebraic quantum volume). At q = q_0 the conjectured scale is

  \alpha = \lvert\alpha_{q_0}\rvert
         = m_e \times \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3)
         = m_e \times 8G ,

where G = \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} (-1)^k/(2k+1)^2 is Catalan's constant and \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3) = 8G is the hyperbolic volume of the Borromean rings complement.

The equality \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3) = 8G is a theorem. The conjectural content is the identification of m_e \cdot 8G as the scale at which binding enters the atomic mass formula; no argument on record derives \lvert\alpha_{q_0}\rvert = m_e \cdot \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3) from the algebraic scale \alpha_q.

Comparison boundary. With m_e set to its CODATA value (the CAL-1 unit), \alpha \approx 3.7445\;\mathrm{MeV}. This numerical value is where the statement meets measurement; it is not part of the conjecture.
heading: Conjecture
